shows.title: Billy Crystal 860
shows.description: *860* is Billy Crystal's one-person show about the Los Angeles fires — and losing his own home.

shows.title: Attention
shows.description: A queer play about why and how we choose to pay attention. About the effort and sweat needed to build a life with someone. About whether love is enough to save us.

shows.title: Ripples
shows.description:
Lost in a world of surveillance and suspicion, one man fights to hold on to who he is and right this wrong.

Based on true events, from debut writer Tafadzwa Muchenje and Stand and Be Counted’s Artistic Director Rosie MacPherson, Ripples is an urgent and electrifying interrogation of Britain’s
treatment of migrants and the relentless power of hope.

shows.title: Insane Asylum Seekers
shows.description: Don’t miss the world premiere of *Insane Asylum Seekers*, the 2023 Tony Craze Award-winning play. This moving and hilarious story is a multi-generational tale spanning a century and exploring the British-Iraqi experience.

shows.title: The Hungry Ghost
shows.description:
Tonight’s the night. She’s got a plan. And it involves her (secret) girlfriend, and the house they're about to move into together.

And it doesn’t matter to her that her mum warns tonight is the first night of the ghost month. Because parents will say anything to keep you home.

shows.title: Darkling
shows.description:
Born under a blue sky in a city of lakes, a girl grows up with her father and sister. The three of them together, always.

But as she grows, the land begins to change. A giant factory rises over her town. Her mother always wanted more for them - now the girl wants more too.
